post.title: [Hiring] LinkedIn ghostwriter for a founder - DM only
post.body: I'm a founder in the HR tech space and want a ghostwriter for 8 LinkedIn posts a month in my voice. Budget $800/month. Please DM me with a sample, I'm not checking comments.

analysis.summary: Ghostwrite 8 LinkedIn posts a month in a HR-tech founder's voice; $800/month.
